destinations.name: Yaoundé
destinations.description: Cameroon's hilly capital, home to national museums, the Unity Palace, and Mfoundi markets.

destinations.name: Douala
destinations.description: The economic capital, known for its port, vibrant nightlife, and the Akwa business district.

destinations.name: Limbe
destinations.description: Black-sand Atlantic beaches, the Limbe Wildlife Centre, and views of Mount Cameroon.

destinations.name: Kribi
destinations.description: White-sand beaches, the Lobé Waterfalls that flow directly into the sea, and fresh grilled fish.

destinations.name: Bafoussam
destinations.description: Heart of the Bamiléké grassfields, known for its markets and traditional chieftaincy palaces.

destinations.name: Bamenda
destinations.description: Cool highland town surrounded by ring-road scenery, waterfalls, and grassfield culture.

destinations.name: Buea
destinations.description: Gateway to Mount Cameroon, West Africa's highest peak, popular with hikers and climbers.

destinations.name: Dschang
destinations.description: Cool climate hill town famous for its municipal lake and forested walking trails.

destinations.name: Garoua
destinations.description: Gateway to Bénoué and Faro national parks, with savanna wildlife and Sahelian culture.

destinations.name: Maroua
destinations.description: Known for leatherwork, the Rhumsiki rock formations nearby, and Sahelian architecture.

destinations.name: Ngaoundéré
destinations.description: Highland cattle-country town near the Tello and Vina waterfalls.

destinations.name: Ebolowa
destinations.description: Forested cocoa-growing town in southern Cameroon, close to Campo Ma'an National Park.

destinations.name: Foumban
destinations.description: Historic Bamoun capital, home to the Royal Palace and Museum and famous bronze artisans.

destinations.name: Bertoua
destinations.description: Gateway to Cameroon's eastern rainforest region and Baka pygmy cultural sites.

destinations.name: Kribi-Campo
destinations.description: Coastal stretch bordering Campo Ma'an National Park, ideal for beach and forest combined trips.
